title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Pineapple Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Pineapple Ice Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod delivers a tropical fruit flavour sharpened by a cooling finish. Sweet, juicy Pineapple comes through clearly on the inhale, while the icy edge refreshes the exhale for a bright and balanced vape. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that keeps the pod topped up automatically. Together they provide up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, with no messy refilling or coil replacements required. Built with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod produces smooth vapour and consistent flavour all the way through. Made exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to vape.
